name: paper
label: Paper
css: .style-paper { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--slide-text, #111827); font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; } .style-paper::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100"><filter id="noise"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="4" result="noise" /></filter><rect width="100" height="100" fill="%23f5f5f5" filter="url(%23noise)" opacity="0.03"/></svg>'); pointer-events: none; } .style-paper .hook { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; word-break: break-word; } .style-paper .text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; } .style-paper .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-family: 'PT Mono', monospace; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; } .style-paper .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 64px; left: 64px; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; z-index: 2; } .slide-code.style-paper { background-color: var(--slide-dark-base, #1a1a1a); background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100"><filter id="noise-dark"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.9" numOctaves="4" result="noise" /></filter><rect width="100" height="100" fill="%23000000" filter="url(%23noise-dark)" opacity="0.15"/></svg>'); color: #e8e8e8; } .slide-code.style-paper .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); } .slide-code.style-paper .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); } .slide-code.style-paper .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-paper { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-dark-base, #1a1a1a) 0%, var(--slide-dark-base, #1a1a1a) 100%); background-attachment: fixed; color: #e8e8e8; } .slide-insight.style-paper .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } .slide-insight.style-paper .insight-text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 42px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; color: #ffffff; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; margin: 32px 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .slide-insight.style-paper .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); } .slide-insight.style-paper .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #111111); opacity: 0.1; }
